turns.text: Totally agree, sometimes a simple drip coffee is exactly what you need. How is the rest of your day looking? Have you had a chance to eat lunch yet?

turns.text: He did! I brought some over to his place yesterday. We had a nice, quiet Sunday after going out salsa dancing on Saturday night.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Salsa dancing sounds like a blast! It must feel great to have your energy completely back after recovering from the flu recently.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. I'm feeling completely back to normal. Phoenix has had some beautiful fall weather too, so I might try to walk around a bit after my shift ends today.

turns.speaker: assistant
